analysis.method: Each sample uses timeDeltas[i]. Exclude node:inspector post stacks outside the measured world window. Attribute once to its nearest read validation, read recording, copy/freeze or GC frame; otherwise to its nearest semantic subsystem. Buckets partition retained sampled wall time. Inclusive functions count recursion once per sample and overlap. GC is separately sampled, not charged to an allocation site.
